LeaderboardScore.title: LeaderboardScore
LeaderboardScore.description: A verified arcade run score submitted by an authenticated player to the public global leaderboard.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player who achieved this score.

playerName.description: Public arcade display name shown on the global leaderboard.

score.description: Final point total earned during the run (0 to 10,000,000).

snakeLength.description: Final articulated snake segment length (3 to 5,000).

obstaclesCleared.description: Count of kinetic bumper deflections, wrap portal warps, and sliding barrier passes.

difficulty.description: Arena physics difficulty preset for the run.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the score was recorded.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private player profile and personal best telemetry restricted to the account owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document identifier.

email.description: Verified account email address (private to owner).

bestScore.description: Highest verified cloud score achieved by the user.

bestLength.description: Longest snake segment length achieved by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent profile update.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Immutable public arcade high-score entries containing zero PII.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-restricted player profile documents storing personal bests and email.
